fit_reason: Although posted under cars by owner, the seller's text describes multiple vehicles with down-payment financing and on-the-spot approval, which points to a dealer or buy-here-pay-here operation rather than a private owner selling their own vehicle.
findings: Light grime and scuffing on the rear bumper, most visible in the rear three-quarter shots
Grey paint looks somewhat flat and dull on the hood and doors in the overcast photos
Dirt and road film along the lower doors and rocker area
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2014 Infiniti QX60. The rear bumper has some scuffing and the grey paint looks a little dull in the photos. We do mobile pre-sale details, including wash, wax and small touch-ups, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
